call_points.text: Aunta-Simaria HAM divestment signed at ~₹1,000 Cr enterprise value; completion expected in Q2 FY27.
Pune-Shirur appointed date expected in Q3 FY27; revenue recognition of ~₹500 Cr expected this financial year.
Aunta-Simaria completion expected to reduce about ₹800 Cr of debt.
Q1 execution hit by Mumbai construction stoppage, geopolitical supply disruption and election-related labour migration.
Revised FDP for MB-OSN-2005/2 submitted; approval expected in 4-6 weeks, production about 2 years after approval.
Smart Ops revenue potential of ₹50-100 Cr, but no formal guidance given.
FY27 revenue growth guided at 15-20%, maintained from prior guidance.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 18%+, below FY26's 23% due to supply-chain risks.
Net debt at ₹43 Cr with cash of ₹1,728 Cr as of March 2026.
Supply-chain disruptions and geopolitical issues could cause near-term cost and execution challenges.
WMEL targeting 20% revenue growth in FY27 and 25% CAGR over three years.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Welspun Sattanathapuram Nagapattinam Road Private Limited (a subsidiary of Welspun Enterprises Limited) is taking appropriate steps to file a detailed reply against each of the SCNs. The alleged difference is arising due to inaccurate reporting by our customer in the relevant Form GSTR-7 returns. The Company is of the view that the demands raised in the SCNs are without merits and are expected to be set aside during the adjudication proceedings. The Company does not foresee any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.
tax_litigation.status: Out of the total proposed tax demand of Rs. 21,86,29,346/- in the SCNs dated 25.09.2025 (3 SCNs), the Adjudicating Authority has issued Orders confirming tax demand of Rs. 2,61,308/- along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 74 of the CGST Act, 2017. Without prejudice to the merits of the case, given the negligible quantum of the dues sought as per the Order, the Company has paid the applicable dues. Accordingly, the said litigation stands closed. The Company would like to mention that such dues does not have any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: M/s Welspun Kaveri Infraprojects JV, a joint venture of Welspun Enterprises Limited and Kaveri Infraprojects Private Limited is taking appropriate steps to file a detailed reply against the SCN issued by adjudicating authority after conducting necessary reconciliation. The alleged difference seems to be on account of difference in reporting in the relevant Form GSTR-7 returns by our client V/s. our returns. tax_litigation.status: Out of the total proposed tax demand of Rs. 48,86,62,934/-, the Adjudicating Authority has issued Order confirming tax demand of Rs. 18,40,73,256 along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017. The alleged difference on which tax demand is confirmed is due to incorrect values reported by the Customer in Form GSTR-7 filed for FY 2021-22 and hence, there is no short payment of tax. The Company has filed an appeal against the Order before the First Level Appellate Authority. The Company does not foresee any material impact on financial or operational or other activities of the Company.
